BiblicalUsage: Ziz is the ascent by which the enemies of Judah came up against Jehoshaphat. In 2 Chronicles 20:16, they come up by the cliff of Ziz.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ziz reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
